description:
Audio Cassette Tape Lot - 4 Tapes
TDK & Maxell, Late 1980s-1990s
Analog Audio Cassettes with Jewel Cases
Lot of four vintage audio cassette tapes featuring quality magnetic media from premier manufacturers TDK and Maxell. These cassettes showcase popular late 20th-century tape formulations, including high-bias Type II and normal-bias Type I formats, enclosed in protective hard plastic cases with J-card inserts.
1x Maxell XLII-S 90 High Position IEC Type II CrO2 cassette
1x TDK D90 Dynamic Cassette Normal Position IEC Type I tape
1x TDK D50 Dynamic Cassette Normal Position IEC Type I tape
1x TDK cassette tape with clear shell and case insert
Each cassette housed in a transparent plastic case with J-card liner
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition. Cassettes feature previous home recordings with handwritten titles on tape labels and J-card liner sleeves as pictured. Tape spools appear intact and neatly wound with no visible creases or unraveling. Jewel cases display light cosmetic shelf wear and surface scuffing consistent with age.

description:
Circa 1920s-30s - Length: 2-3/4”
The Cap & Barrel: The engraving reads "18KT - 1/10 GOLD FILLED". This indicates a high-grade manufacturing process where a thick layer of solid 18-karat gold is mechanically bonded to a base metal core. In the 1920s, a 1/10 fractional ratio was exceptionally generous, meaning 10% of the total overlay metal's weight is true gold (more common vintage pens often used a thinner 1/20 ratio).\n• The Nib: The stamp confirms it is a solid 14-karat gold nib. Nibs from this era especially those coming from former Waterman craftsmen are highly celebrated among modern collectors for their impressive smoothness and flexible expression.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Aqua Glass Telephone Pole Insulator w/ Iron Peg
Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base. Includes original wrought iron pole mounting peg/pin with wood-covered threaded shaft, used to attach the insulator to utility poles. Both pieces show age-appropriate wear consistent with antique railroad/telegraph line hardware, including surface rust on the iron peg and natural glass wear with embedded dirt. Authentic antique collectible pairing a Hemingray glass insulator with its matching iron pin. Popular among insulator and telegraphiana collectors.
10 x 4 x 4 in

cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

This lot includes vintage Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) video games with both boxed and loose cartridges. Boxed titles: Battletoads by Tradewest, Tetris, Pipe Dream by Bullet-Proof Software, and Super Sprint by Tengen. Loose cartridges include Super Mario Bros. 3, Yoshi, Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse by Konami, The Goonies II, The Karate Kid, Dig Dug II, Donkey Kong Classics, Monopoly, The Little Mermaid by Capcom, and multiple copies of Super Mario Bros./Duck Hunt. Items show typical wear of used NES games, with some boxes having creases and edge wear. Suitable for collectors or retro gaming enthusiasts.

description:
Mighty Beanz Lot
Carrying Cases, Storage Tubes, and Loose Figures Collection
Molded Plastic and Metal, Early 2000s
This extensive Mighty Beanz collection includes a large assortment of original early 2000s collectible tumbling bean figures alongside approximately 25 individual plastic carrying cases. First popularized by Moose Toys in the early 2000s, Mighty Beanz became a global schoolyard collectible phenomenon characterized by their distinctive weighted ball bearing center that creates dynamic rolling action.
Large lot featuring dozens of assorted character beanz and specialty figures
Includes approximately 25 blue, red, and orange clip-on carrying tube cases
Features stamped Mighty Beanz branding on exterior case bodies
Includes bonus collector card and storage container with loose assortment
Condition:
Overall very good pre-owned condition across all pieces. Figures display clean graphics with light play wear and surface scuffs consistent with age. Plastic carrying cases open, close, and snap shut securely with clean hinge mechanisms. No major cracks, breaks, or structural damage observed throughout the collection.

description:
Vintage Promotional Wall Calendar Lot
The Travelers & Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance
Paper & Cardboard Ephemera, Circa 1950s
This estate collection features vintage 1950s promotional wall calendars and art prints issued by prominent American insurance firms, including The Travelers Insurance Company of Hartford, Connecticut, and The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company. Highly regarded for their high-quality lithographic reproductions, these corporate calendars showcased classic American artwork, including Currier & Ives historical lithographs and John James Audubon wildlife plates.
Items Included:
1953 The Travelers wall calendar featuring Currier & Ives prints such as "The Home of Washington, Mount Vernon, Va." and "Morning in the Woods"
1957 The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company Centennial Anniversary calendar with Audubon "Mallard Duck" artwork
Standalone illustrated botanical art sheet featuring a detailed green oak tree
Multiple rolled calendar tubes and original postal shipping tubes housed in a cardboard storage box
Condition:
Paper shows vintage toning, edge curling, foxing, and age-related wear consistent with rolled storage. Outer paper sleeves and mailing tubes display tears, fraying, tape residue, and chipping. Prints retain clear details and legible typography. Hanging metal strips and eyelets present on calendars.

title: Vintage Glass Insulator 3 Piece Lot Hemingray O.V.G. Co Aqua Green Damaged
description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

description:
Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones
Condition:
All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.

description:
Arizona Petrified Wood
Polished Fossil Slab Display Specimen
Late Triassic Period
Originating from northeastern Arizona, this petrified wood slab dates to the Late Triassic period, over 200 million years ago. Silica replaced buried wood fibers while iron and manganese oxides imparted rich tones of brick red, amber, and black. The piece showcases fine fossilization with a polished face and authentic rough outer bark.
Polished display face highlighting mineral banding and grain structure
Natural rough rind preserving the exterior tree bark texture
Flat cut bottom with four protective cork pads for upright display
Includes educational informational card on Arizona petrified wood
Dimensions: 7.2" H x 6.6" W x 2.2" D; Weight: 1.65 lbs
Condition:
Polished surface is smooth with natural internal micro-fissures inherent to fossilized stone. Natural rough edges are intact. Base is cut flat and stands upright securely; partial label residue on underside. Information card has handling creases.

description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
